rows.name: Country Acres Generation Project
rows.quote: Country Acres Generation Project is a 344 MW solar combined with 172 MW battery hybrid generation power plant with 344 MW power output at the Point of Interconnection (POI). The Country Acres project will be interconnected through a new 230 kV switch station

rows.name: Elverta (El Rio) 230 kV Substation Rebuild and Expansion
rows.quote: 2. Elverta (El Rio) 230 kV Substation Rebuild and Expansion (2024 Waiver Granted) The proposed in-service date of this project is December of 2026.
